title: Private Local Libations Tour, Victoria, BC
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Customized private tour sampling award-winning, locally crafted wines, spirits, beers and ciders. On this full-day tour, you'll discover three local producers. Stops will be selected based on your drink preferences and availability. 

There are plenty of food options available thoughout the day and lots of time to relax and enjoy the stunning views.
